+import XCTest
+
+final class ElementNavigationUITests: XCTestCase {
+    private func tap(_ app: XCUIApplication, label: String) {
+        let candidates = [
+            app.buttons[label],
+            app.staticTexts[label],
+            app.cells[label],
+            app.otherElements[label],
+            app.images[label]
+        ]
+
+        if let element = candidates.first(where: { $0.exists && $0.isHittable }) {
+            element.tap()
+            return
+        }
+
+        if let element = candidates.first(where: { $0.exists }) {
+            element.tap()
+            return
+        }
+
+        XCTFail("Missing element: \(label)")
+    }
+
+    func testNavigateToSecurityPrivacySettings() {
+        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
+        app.activate()
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(app.buttons["User menu"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10) || app.otherElements["User menu"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
+        tap(app, label: "User menu")
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(app.buttons["User settings"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10) || app.staticTexts["User settings"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
+        tap(app, label: "User settings")
+
+        _ = app.staticTexts["Settings"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10)
+
+        var landed = false
+        for _ in 0..<8 {
+            if app.buttons["Security"].exists || app.staticTexts["Security"].exists || app.staticTexts["SECURITY"].exists {
+                landed = true
+                break
+            }
+            app.swipeUp()
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(landed || app.buttons["Security"].exists || app.staticTexts["Security"].exists || app.staticTexts["SECURITY"].exists)
+    }
+}
